leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: I'd Like / Would You Like…?
leadIn.content: At a café or restaurant: 'What would you like to order?' — 'I'd like a cup of coffee, please.'

form.title: Form & Structure: I'd Like / Would You Like…?
form.content: I'd like (+ noun / + to + base verb). Polite offer/request: Would you like (+ noun / + to + base verb)?
